title: People and places in one list
statementMd:
Produce a single list of text values containing every employee's first name and every department name. Show the column once and keep duplicates out.

Expected columns: `label`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT first_name AS label FROM employees UNION SELECT name FROM departments;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.

expected.query: SELECT first_name AS label FROM employees UNION SELECT name FROM departments;
